# DataplexAsset

`dataplex.gcp.hfl.dev/v1beta1`

**Gap it fills.** Terraform's `google_dataplex_asset`. A bucket or dataset attached to a Dataplex zone.

**Source.** generated by `hack/discokind` from the dataplex.v1 Discovery document.

## Notes

Generated by `hack/discokind` from `hack/discokind/kinds.yaml` (`docs/design.md`
section 2.4); its test is `pkg/discokind/kindtest` with the fixtures under
`pkg/controller/direct/dataplex/testdata/discokind/DataplexAsset/`.

Dataplex allows 10 requests a minute per user and region, shared by the
controller, the test and anything else the account runs. A refusal for
quota (429) requeues the object after a growing wait and never marks it
failed (`docs/design.md` decision 31); an operation is read less often
as it goes on. The test reads the cloud every 10 s live and retries its
own refused calls. Live, `setup_test.go` makes each asset's lake, zone (`RAW`, single region, discovery off) and Cloud Storage bucket in us-central1 first and deletes them afterwards, children first. The sweeper deletes a run's zones and assets before
its lakes.

Dataplex answers `resourceSpec.name` with the bucket's bare name whatever
path was sent (`projects/P/buckets/B`); the controller counts the two as
the same (`sameBucket` in `pkg/discokind`), where it used to see a
difference and patch the asset on every reconcile (run
`cce-11140351-e560`: Ready, but updated for 15 minutes).
